meta.name: gtm-strategy
meta.description: Create a go-to-market strategy covering marketing channels, messaging, success metrics, and launch timeline. Use when planning a product launch, creating a GTM plan from scratch, or defining a launch strategy for a new market.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定产品上市策略，覆盖渠道、信息、指标和时间线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在规划产品发布或进入新市场，需要完整的上市策略
copy.tagline_en: Create a go-to-market strategy covering channels, messaging, metrics, and timeline
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning a product launch or entering a new market and need a complete GTM strategy

howto.what: Claude 会引导你逐步创建一份上市策略文档，涵盖营销渠道、信息传达、成功指标和发布时间表。
howto.when: 当你计划产品发布、从头制定上市计划或为新市场定义发布策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我为新产品制定上市策略。
say.note: Claude 会开始收集产品信息并生成完整策略。

say.text: 分析我的目标市场并推荐营销渠道。
say.note: Claude 会评估渠道并给出建议。

say.text: 为我的产品发布创建90天执行路线图。
say.note: Claude 会输出分阶段的时间表和里程碑。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you step-by-step to create a go-to-market strategy document covering marketing channels, messaging, success metrics, and launch timeline.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you plan a product launch, create a GTM plan from scratch, or define a launch strategy for a new market.

say_en.text: Help me create a go-to-market strategy for a new product.
say_en.note: Claude will start gathering product info and generate a full strategy.

say_en.text: Analyze my target market and recommend marketing channels.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate channels and give suggestions.

say_en.text: Create a 90-day execution roadmap for my product launch.
say_en.note: Claude will output a phased timeline with milestones.
